[[File:Nicoletti Onorato.jpg|thumb|220 px|Onoratio Nicoletti]]
'''Onorato Nicoletti''' (21 June 1872 – 31 December 1929)<ref>{{Cite web |title=Onorato Nicoletti - Biography |url=https://mathshistory.st-andrews.ac.uk/Biographies/Nicoletti/ |access-date=2024-02-14 |website=Maths History |language=en}}</ref> was an Italian mathematician.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.treccani.it/enciclopedia/nicoletti-onorato_%28Dizionario-delle-Scienze-Fisiche%29/|title=Biografia sul Dizionario Treccani delle Scienze Fisiche}}</ref>

==Biography==
Nicoletti received his ''laurea'' in 1894 from the [[Scuola Normale di Pisa]]. In 1898, he became a professor of infinitesimal calculus at the [[University of Modena]]. After two years, he returned to Pisa, where he was a teacher of algebra, and then, after the death of [[Ulisse Dini]], of infinitesimal calculus.<ref>{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20130413112109/http://www.sba.unipi.it/content/persona-archivio/nicoletti-onorato|title=Nicoletti Onorato}} estesa biografia sul sito dell'Università di Pisa</ref>

He published works in various fields of mathematics, including numerical analysis, infinitesimal analysis, the equations related to [[hermitian matrix|hermitian matrices]], and [[differential equations]]. He made original contributions to [[Max Dehn]]'s theory of the equivalence of polyhedra under polyhedral dissection and reassembly ([[scissors-congruent|scissors-congruence]]), extending and generalizing the theory with an entire class of new relations.

Nicoletti collaborated in the writing of ''Enciclopedia Hoepli delle Matematiche elementari e complementi'' (published from 1930 to 1951) with the contribution of two monographic articles: ''Forme razionali di una o più variabili'' (Rational forms of one or more variables) and ''Proprietà generali delle funzioni algebriche'' (General properties of algebraic functions).

A leading expert in mathematics education, he edited with [[Roberto Marcolongo]] a series of successful editions for secondary schools.

Nicoletti was an Invited Speaker of the [[International Congress of Mathematicians|ICM]] in Rome.<ref>{{cite book|author=Nicoletti, O.|chapter=Sulla riduzione a forma canonica di un fascio di forme bilineari e quadratiche|editor=G. Castelnuovo|title=Atti del IV Congresso Internazionale dei Matematici (Roma, 6–11 Aprile 1908)|year=1909|volume=2|pages=163–168|chapter-url=http://www.mathunion.org/ICM/ICM1908.2/Main/icm1908.2.0163.0168.ocr.pdf|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171207140920/http://www.mathunion.org/ICM/ICM1908.2/Main/icm1908.2.0163.0168.ocr.pdf |archive-date=2017-12-07 }}</ref>
